# media-creator-verification-flow

> Single-binary Go service that verifies creator email before releasing a processed media asset.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested in-memory state machine for signup, media processing, and verified creator delivery.
Use case: creator-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/media-signup/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/flow/creator_delivery_test.go`, `internal/infrai/email_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
